title: One physical language for HUD controls
status: Historical read-ahead; activated only after Goal3 merged404/main47b0b5e9. Concrete acceptance/source decisions now in goal-04-acceptance.json.
sourceLimit: Goal 2 is active. FallingSkyHUD has a separate dirty score-reservation correction; this review reads the current shared control owners only. Re-read the actual merged source at goal 4 activation.
alreadyImplemented: Forecast targets have 44-point minimums, reserved underline space, selected trait, disabled ink/desaturation, focus outline and immediate pressed surface.
Inspection is one native 48-point utility in the forecast group with complete spoken name, busy gating and source-bound Return.
Utility controls already retain full hit regions, focus circles and native button cancellation. ObservatoryIcon owns registered original-color artwork and disabled desaturation/opacity.
Existing selected-column, live inspector, background/world, Full Board absence and exact round/save/clock outcomes remain required.

concreteResidual.utilityPressed: Utility applies0.92 to the24-point style allocation, yielding22.08 points; actual HUD ObservatoryIcon callers request20 points, so their image frame becomes18.4 during press. Preserve each caller-selected original size rather than assuming every glyph renders at24 points.
concreteResidual.forecastPressed: Forecast/gameplay content keeps its size and gains surfacePressed material on its existing shape.
concreteResidual.focus: Both use moonlight focus, but utility hard-codes 2-point stroke while forecast uses the shared focusWidth token; circle and rounded target shapes serve their current contexts.
concreteResidual.disabled: ObservatoryIcon already uses saturation 0.25 and opacity 0.5; forecast content uses disabled ink and saturation 0.25. Applying a second shared opacity to utilities would double-dim their glyphs.
concreteResidual.evidenceScope: Source-observed differences; no new native visual defect or input failure is claimed.

smallestVisibleCandidate: Give inspection/pause utilities the same immediate pressed-surface material response as forecast controls while preserving each original caller-selected glyph size (20-point pause/help inside24-point allocation) and fixed targets.

Keep state constants in the shared theme/styles: pressed material, enabled/disabled ink and focus weight. A narrow shared visual modifier is appropriate only if both owners need the same change; no generic input/state framework.
Retain selected forecast underline as persistent selection, distinct from transient press and platform focus. Keep all decoration passive and preserve native Button gesture/action ownership.
Use the existing registered glyphs and materials; prove actual-size help/pause detail at 2×/3× before considering any asset change.

stateContracts.visible: Original glyph and readable label over current fitted protection; no new permanent utility bezel.

stateContracts.visible: Immediate common material response; glyph/text do not shrink or shift.

stateContracts.mechanical: Real platform focus remains separate from selection and press. Hosted visual focus evidence is not actual VoiceOver acceptance.

nativeAcceptance: Paused normal-phone Lantern: drag a forecast chip outside its target and release; no selected column or game/score/archive change. A subsequent inside tap selects the exact actual column.

Drag the inspection utility outside and release; no sheet opens. Then tap normally, inspect exact source facts, Return and reopen once without a retry. Preserve unchanged round/world and complete 44/48-point gates.
Selected+pressed and selected+focused remain distinguishable; background/replacement/real exchange retire the old selection with unchanged source/generation checks.
Actual AX5 Calm tablet retains all five targets, native column contact, real 15,000 chain and Full Board absence. Normal-motion Frostfruit inspector still leaves the existing live clock running.
Inspect source-bound actual contact footage for press/depress and release/cancel appearance. A post-release still alone does not prove the transient pressed state.

For real-busy disabled state, first use existing real Store/presenter ownership to hold a genuine busy phase and prove unchanged admission. Native touch acceptance is recorded only when the actual disabled state is observed; a supplied preview flag is visual evidence only.
